findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_series, create_booking, share_booking_as_invitee, join_waitlist · Private data: get_available_slots, create_booking, get_booking, reschedule_booking_as_invitee, cancel_booking_as_invitee, get_shared_booking · Public sink: create_booking, share_booking_as_invitee, join_waitlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_series, create_booking, share_booking_as_invitee, join_waitlist · Private data: get_available_slots, create_booking, get_booking, reschedule_booking_as_invitee, cancel_booking_as_invitee, get_shared_booking · Public sink: create_booking, share_booking_as_invitee, join_waitlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
